name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel Chart
description: The steps of a process that people (or things) drop out of, as centred bars that narrow with the count, each with its count, its share of the first step and its share of the step before.

meta.when: Showing where a sequence loses the most: sign-up steps, a sales pipeline, a hiring process. For flows that split and join use sankey-chart; for amounts that are not a sequence use bar-chart horizontal.
meta.example:
<FunnelChart
  label="Sign-up steps"
  data={[
    { step: "Visited", people: 1200 },
    { step: "Started", people: 640 },
    { step: "Confirmed email", people: 410 },
    { step: "Finished", people: 290 },
  ]}
  x="step"
  value="people"
/>
